summary: Frontend-only visual/regression test of the animation + login relabel round, at 1920 and 390. /login: blue button reads 'Organizer' + 'Synthetic example' and lands on /project; 'Partner' toggle animates height 0 -> ~288px (55,177,241,275,287,288 sampled every 60ms) with opacity 0->1; alder/birch 'Use' lands on /reviews. Sign in/Create account pill slides (mid-transition translateX 111px, ends exactly over the active tab at both widths); panels end at opacity 1; register (TEST_anim_*@example.com) -> /project, sign-in form wrong pw shows error, right pw -> /project. Project: step switches leave no opacity:0 elements; schedule rows animate (opacity 0 -> 1 staggered) after generating with alder/birch/cedar; decide strip children opacity 1; reset dialog cancel/confirm and History drawer open/Esc close work; sticky readings bar sticks at top 64px after scroll and Select all/Use selected readings work. No page overflow at 390 (doc/body scrollWidth 390; grid scrolls inside its container 420/356). No page errors. Found and FIXED 2 bugs (see rca).

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: hover lift never moved cards. `.stagger > *` used animation-fill-mode `both`, so the finished animation kept transform: translateY(0) and overrode `.lift:hover` transform (computed transform stayed identity on hover; only the shadow changed). Changed fill-mode to `backwards` on .rise, .stagger, .rows-in, tabpanel and alert/status animations. After the fix the hover transform is translateY(-1px).

FIXED: `inert={showPartners ? undefined : ""}`. React 19 treats inert as a boolean, so the empty string set nothing. The hidden 'Use' buttons in the collapsed list stayed keyboard-focusable: Tab from the toggle went to signin-demo-alder-button. Changed to `inert={!showPartners}`. Now Tab goes to signin-tab when the list is collapsed, and the list is not inert when open.

issues: Switching to Create account unmounts the Organizer/Partner block, and the page is vertically centered (min-h-screen items-center), so the whole card jumps about 300px instead of animating. Consider keeping height stable or animating the block out. Low priority.

action_items: Review the 2 small fixes applied by the testing agent (index.css fill-mode backwards; Login.jsx inert boolean)
Optional: soften the vertical jump on /login when switching tabs
critical_code_review_comments: Avoid animation-fill-mode `both`/`forwards` on elements that also get transform/opacity from hover or state classes; the held end keyframe overrides them.
React 19: pass booleans to `inert`, not empty strings.
